host_compatibility.workflow_membership_note: A skill may support a workflow without appearing as one of its primary stages; membership is discoverability metadata, not an exact stage partition.

category_guidance.Discovery & Planning: Clarify the problem, shape scope, and choose a grounded starting point.
category_guidance.Feature Delivery: Carry a bounded feature from plan through implementation and release readiness.
category_guidance.Debugging & Repair: Reproduce failures, find causes, and land a verified fix.
category_guidance.Review & Quality: Evaluate changes, address findings, and prove maintainability before review.
category_guidance.Security & Risk: Model threats and inspect sensitive changes for exploitable gaps.
category_guidance.Codebase Improvement: Reduce complexity, modernize structure, and protect behavior during refactors.
category_guidance.Testing & Verification: Design and execute checks that make expected behavior observable.
category_guidance.Agent Operations: Bound, coordinate, checkpoint, and hand off agent work safely.

catalog.surface_note: Commands, hooks, installers, build helpers, and internal repository copies are compatibility or tooling surfaces, not native plugin skills.

skills.primary_purpose: Turn a reported defect into a reproducible, diagnosed, verified fix.
use_when: A bug report needs reproduction, root-cause analysis, a minimal patch, and regression evidence.
avoid_when: The request is a new feature or a broad refactor without a concrete defect.
skills.preferred_context: Issue report, reproduction steps, expected and actual behavior, logs, and relevant code.
example_prompts: Investigate this report, reproduce it, and make the smallest verified fix.
Find the root cause of this failing behavior and add regression coverage.

documentation_completeness.notes: Canonical skill and agent metadata are present.

skills.primary_purpose: Verify pre-PR code quality evidence before a change enters review.
use_when: A branch needs a pre-PR quality verdict covering correctness, maintainability, tests, and risk.
avoid_when: You only need a narrow syntax check, focused test command, or release-only checklist.
skills.preferred_context: Diff, repository conventions, validation commands, test results, and known risk areas.
example_prompts: Run the repository quality gate on this change and report blockers.
Assess whether this branch is ready for review, including tests and maintainability.

documentation_completeness.notes: Canonical skill and agent metadata are present.

skills.primary_purpose: Add or improve focused test coverage for the behavior changed by a task.
use_when: A fix or feature needs regression protection and executable evidence of expected behavior.
avoid_when: The repository has no testable seam and a test would only duplicate implementation details.
skills.preferred_context: Acceptance criteria, changed code paths, existing test conventions, and failure cases.
example_prompts: Add focused regression coverage for this bug fix.
Identify the highest-value tests for this change and implement them.

documentation_completeness.notes: Canonical skill and agent metadata are present.

skills.primary_purpose: Identify code with combined complexity and weak coverage so improvement effort is prioritized.
use_when: A codebase needs evidence-based prioritization of risky, complex, or under-tested areas.
avoid_when: A single failing behavior needs diagnosis rather than structural risk analysis.
skills.preferred_context: Complexity measurements, coverage reports, hotspots, and repository constraints.
example_prompts: Run CRAP analysis on my branch changes and list the hotspots above the threshold.
Prioritize refactoring targets using complexity and test evidence.

documentation_completeness.notes: Canonical skill and agent metadata are present.

skills.primary_purpose: Produce a concise, evidence-backed handoff that lets another agent resume work safely.
use_when: Work may pause, transfer ownership, or cross an agent/session boundary.
avoid_when: The task is complete and needs only a user-facing summary.
skills.preferred_context: Plan, current state, changed files, decisions, checks, blockers, and next action.
example_prompts: Write a resumable handoff for the current implementation state.
Capture decisions, checks, risks, and the exact next step for another agent.

documentation_completeness.notes: Canonical skill and agent metadata are present.

skills.primary_purpose: Maintain durable context and boundaries across a multi-phase implementation.
use_when: A task spans phases, agents, or context windows and must retain state without redoing work.
avoid_when: The change is small enough to complete in one uninterrupted session.
skills.preferred_context: Approved plan, phase state, acceptance criteria, evidence, and deferred scope.
example_prompts: Set up durable phase context for this multi-step implementation.
Reconcile the plan, progress, evidence, and next task before continuing.

documentation_completeness.notes: Canonical skill and agent metadata are present.

skills.primary_purpose: Review whether a delivery phase met its evidence and acceptance criteria before proceeding.
use_when: A phased task needs an explicit checkpoint before the next implementation or release step.
avoid_when: There is no phase boundary or the work has no defined acceptance evidence.
skills.preferred_context: Phase plan, completed work, checks, acceptance criteria, risks, and deferred items.
example_prompts: Review this phase against its acceptance criteria and decide whether it can close.
Run a phase gate and list required corrections before continuing.

documentation_completeness.notes: Canonical skill and agent metadata are present.

skills.primary_purpose: Deliver approved requirements or tickets through test-first implementation in reviewable phases, one PR per phase.
use_when: A requirement, plan, or approved project ticket set needs implementation through human-reviewed PRs.
An existing implementation plan needs a report-only readiness check before execution.
avoid_when: The request is only to define requirements, or an unattended runner owns execution and merge.
skills.preferred_context: Source requirement or approved tickets, acceptance criteria, dependencies, repository state, and PR branch strategy.
expected_outputs: One reviewable PR per phase or ticket
Red/green test evidence and unit-test coverage gaps
example_prompts: Use Phased Delivery to implement these approved tickets as stacked PRs, one ticket per PR.
Plan and deliver this requirement in reviewable phases.
Implement this feature test-first and cover its important unit-test branches.
Review this plan for missing requirements and disconnected components.

documentation_completeness.notes: Canonical skill and agent metadata are present.

skills.primary_purpose: Apply review-driven improvements and verify that a pull request is stronger after feedback.
use_when: A pull request has actionable findings that need implementation and re-checking.
avoid_when: No review findings exist or the task is a fresh implementation.
skills.preferred_context: Pull request diff, review findings, repository checks, and unresolved threads.
example_prompts: Apply the actionable review findings on this pull request and rerun checks.
Improve this PR from the review comments, preserving intent and documenting tradeoffs.

skills.primary_purpose: Review a change for correctness, regressions, maintainability, and delivery risk.
use_when: A pull request or diff needs an independent, evidence-backed review.
avoid_when: The request is only to implement a known change and no review is needed yet.
skills.preferred_context: Diff, base branch, issue or acceptance criteria, tests, and repository conventions.
example_prompts: Review this PR for correctness, regressions, and maintainability.
Perform a risk-focused code review of this diff and report actionable findings first.

skills.primary_purpose: Respond to pull request review threads with concise evidence and clear disposition.
use_when: Review comments need replies that explain fixes, decisions, or justified non-changes.
avoid_when: The pull request has not been reviewed or needs implementation rather than communication.
skills.preferred_context: Review thread, changed code, check results, and project conventions.
example_prompts: Draft evidence-backed replies to the open review threads.
Respond to these PR comments and distinguish fixes from justified non-changes.

documentation_completeness.notes: Canonical skill and agent metadata are present.

skills.primary_purpose: Turn an opportunity or problem into evidence-backed scope and a useful next decision.

avoid_when: Acceptance criteria and implementation scope are already settled.

skills.primary_purpose: Plan and execute a safe, repeatable retrofit across an existing codebase.

skills.preferred_context: Trust boundaries, sensitive data, dependencies, configuration, findings policy, and safe test scope.

skills.primary_purpose: Work through architecture questions and produce evidence-backed designs, diagrams, decision records, or current repository maps.

Design this service and review its attack paths.
Create an architecture document with diagrams, decision records, and explicit open questions.
Document why we chose this architecture and what would make us reconsider it.

Update the repository map after this entry point moved.

workflows.name: Product decisions and learning
workflows.purpose: Connect research, opportunity decisions, experiments, and customer outcome evidence. Use only the stages needed for the decision.

stages.rationale: Understand source evidence, counterexamples, and sample limits.
stages.example_invocation: Synthesize this customer research.

stages.rationale: Choose an opportunity or experiment with measurement and decision conditions.
stages.example_invocation: Compare these opportunities and define the next experiment.

stages.rationale: Clarify selected implementation scope when a brief is needed.
stages.example_invocation: Shape this selected opportunity into a brief.

stages.rationale: Deliver approved scope with acceptance evidence.
stages.example_invocation: Deliver the approved brief in reviewable phases.

stages.rationale: Assess immediate release readiness and health when a release is involved.
stages.example_invocation: Prepare this change for release using project thresholds.

stages.rationale: Determine whether the original customer problem improved.
stages.example_invocation: Review this experiment against its hypothesis and baseline.

workflows.name: Feature delivery
workflows.purpose: Move a bounded product or engineering idea from discovery through implementation, verification, review, and release readiness.

stages.rationale: Clarify the user problem and evidence before committing to a solution.
stages.example_invocation: Explore this problem and produce a decision-ready brief.

stages.rationale: Bound appetite, solution direction, rabbit holes, and explicit exclusions.
stages.example_invocation: Shape this brief into a bounded implementation scope.

stages.rationale: Implement approved behavior test-first in reviewable phases, one PR per phase or ticket.
stages.example_invocation: Deliver these approved tickets with failing tests, minimal implementation, and passing tests.

stages.rationale: Check implementation quality, risks, and readiness using repository evidence.
stages.example_invocation: Run the quality gate on this feature branch.

stages.rationale: Perform an independent review before release work.
stages.example_invocation: Review this feature diff for correctness and regressions.

stages.rationale: Prepare rollout, monitoring, rollback, and post-release verification.
stages.example_invocation: Prepare this change for a safe release.

workflows.name: Bug fixing
workflows.purpose: Move a concrete defect from reproduction through diagnosis, regression coverage, review, and release.

stages.rationale: Establish a reproducible failure and smallest defensible fix.
stages.example_invocation: Reproduce this bug, find its root cause, and fix it.

stages.rationale: Prevent recurrence with focused behavior-level coverage.
stages.example_invocation: Add regression coverage for this failure.

stages.rationale: Exercise user-visible flows when the defect crosses the browser boundary.
stages.example_invocation: Verify the fixed browser flow end to end.

stages.rationale: Confirm the fix is scoped, maintainable, and sufficiently verified.
stages.example_invocation: Run the quality gate for this bug fix.

stages.rationale: Check for regressions or unintended behavior before shipping.
stages.example_invocation: Review the bug-fix diff and regression test.

workflows.name: Pull request review
workflows.purpose: Review, improve, and close feedback on a pull request with explicit evidence and communication.

stages.rationale: Find correctness, regression, maintainability, and risk issues independently.
stages.example_invocation: Review this PR and prioritize actionable findings.

stages.rationale: Implement accepted findings and verify the changes.
stages.example_invocation: Apply the actionable findings and rerun checks.

stages.rationale: Confirm review corrections and evidence are complete before closeout.
stages.example_invocation: Run the review phase gate.

stages.rationale: Reply to each thread with evidence or a clear disposition.
stages.example_invocation: Draft replies for all open review threads.

workflows.name: Technical health and modernization
workflows.purpose: Discover maintenance costs, assess selected items, and verify authorized improvements against their baseline.

stages.rationale: Find demonstrated maintenance costs and report scoped evidence.
stages.example_invocation: Find and prioritize debt in this repository.

stages.rationale: Decide whether a selected item warrants implementation or further evidence.
stages.example_invocation: Assess this selected debt item and its alternatives.

stages.rationale: Use complexity and coverage signals to choose high-value targets.
stages.example_invocation: Find the riskiest complexity and coverage hotspots.

stages.rationale: Remove unnecessary complexity within a narrow behavior boundary.
stages.example_invocation: Simplify this module without changing behavior.

stages.rationale: Handle migrations and compatibility changes incrementally.
stages.example_invocation: Plan and execute this repository retrofit safely.

stages.rationale: Protect behavior while structural changes land.
stages.example_invocation: Add coverage for the refactored behavior.

stages.rationale: Confirm the improvement reduced risk without introducing regressions.
stages.example_invocation: Run the quality gate on this refactor.

workflows.name: System design and security
workflows.purpose: Document architecture, review attack paths, and connect security requirements to implementation evidence.

stages.rationale: Create the design record and linked threat review before implementation.
stages.example_invocation: Document this system and its attack paths.

stages.rationale: Identify assets, trust boundaries, abuse cases, and mitigations before coding.
stages.example_invocation: Threat-model this feature and its data flows.

stages.rationale: Plan accepted requirements and preserve threat-to-verification links.
stages.example_invocation: Plan the accepted design and security requirements.

stages.rationale: Turn threats and requirements into negative, boundary, and regression cases.
stages.example_invocation: Design security-focused test cases for this change.

stages.rationale: Make critical protections executable and regression-resistant.
stages.example_invocation: Implement tests for the security invariants.

stages.rationale: Inspect the resulting implementation and configuration for exploitable gaps.
stages.example_invocation: Audit this security-sensitive diff and prioritize findings.

stages.rationale: Check evidence, maintainability, and release readiness across the risk boundary.
stages.example_invocation: Run the quality gate with security risks in scope.

stages.rationale: Provide independent final review of correctness and residual risk.
stages.example_invocation: Review this security-sensitive PR for residual risk.

tooling_audit.recommendation: Maintain independent plugin validation and require explicit installation for private runner workflows.

tooling_audit.label: install.sh, install/*.sh, and install/lib.sh
tooling_audit.purpose: Install project-scoped commands, templates, workflows, and compatibility files for existing repositories.
tooling_audit.recommendation: Keep as the legacy/project installer; it remains separate from native plugin skill discovery.

tooling_audit.label: commands/
tooling_audit.purpose: Provide project-scoped command prompts for the existing install workflow.
tooling_audit.recommendation: Keep for install.sh consumers, but keep commands suppressed in native Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex plugin manifests.

tooling_audit.label: optional/cursor-hooks/
tooling_audit.purpose: Preserve opt-in Cursor hook behavior without enabling hooks through native plugin discovery.
tooling_audit.recommendation: Keep opt-in and project-installer-managed; do not make it a default plugin component.

tooling_audit.label: build-cursor-plugin.sh and scripts/check-cursor-plugin-build.sh
tooling_audit.purpose: Build and verify the skills-only Cursor package with its required support resources.
tooling_audit.recommendation: Keep as a repeatable packaging and validation path.

tooling_audit.label: scripts/check-plugin-package.js and scripts/check-plugin-package.sh
tooling_audit.purpose: Validate native manifests, catalogs, package inventory, and host-specific plugin contracts.
tooling_audit.recommendation: Keep as release checks; add catalog checks as a separate Phase 1 surface.

tooling_audit.label: scripts/check-skill-shape.sh and scripts/check-skill-sync.sh
tooling_audit.purpose: Protect canonical skill shape and the repository's internal compatibility mirror.
tooling_audit.recommendation: Keep until the installer and sync contract no longer requires the mirror.

tooling_audit.label: .agents/skills/phased-delivery/
tooling_audit.purpose: Maintain the repository-local Phased Delivery skill copy used by existing tooling and checks.
tooling_audit.recommendation: Keep only for the established compatibility contract; do not add additional duplicated skill trees.

tooling_audit.label: .cursor-plugin/, .claude-plugin/, .codex-plugin/, and .agents/plugins/
tooling_audit.purpose: Describe and index the skills-only native plugin for the three supported hosts.
tooling_audit.recommendation: Keep manifests and marketplace metadata aligned; these are plugin metadata, not additional skill copies.

tooling_audit.label: root hooks/ discovery
tooling_audit.purpose: Historical root-level hook discovery that could unintentionally enable behavior in plugin contexts.
tooling_audit.recommendation: Do not restore; the optional/cursor-hooks location preserves explicit compatibility behavior.

tooling_audit.label: Committed duplicated plugin skill trees
tooling_audit.purpose: Avoid duplicate copies that drift from skills/*/SKILL.md.
tooling_audit.recommendation: Do not add; use host manifests, build validation, and the canonical root skill tree.

tooling_audit.label: install.command
tooling_audit.purpose: Offer a double-click macOS entry point for the project-scoped installer.
tooling_audit.recommendation: Keep as an optional convenience; direct install.sh remains the documented cross-platform path.

tooling_audit.label: .cursor/commands/ and .cursor/rules/
tooling_audit.purpose: Provide repo-local contributor and developer configuration for maintaining the collection.
tooling_audit.recommendation: Keep as repository contributor configuration; do not treat it as native plugin payload.

tooling_audit.label: templates/, workflows/, and examples/
tooling_audit.purpose: Supply referenced templates, workflow playbooks, and worked examples used by skills and the project installer.
tooling_audit.recommendation: Keep canonical support content; validate references and avoid duplicating it in the portal.

tooling_audit.label: wiki/
tooling_audit.purpose: Supply essential installation and operational instructions.
tooling_audit.recommendation: Keep usage instructions in the wiki. Keep maintainer reports and evaluation material local.

tooling_audit.label: Local maintainer material
tooling_audit.purpose: Hold local maintainer research and source material when these ignored directories are present.
tooling_audit.recommendation: Keep research, handoff documents, and evaluations outside the repository or in ignored scratch output.

tooling_audit.label: catalog/ and portal/
tooling_audit.purpose: Provide deterministic discovery metadata and the offline capability portal.
tooling_audit.recommendation: Derive discovery content from canonical skill metadata. Generate optional maintainer reports outside published content.

tooling_audit.label: Project-owned delivery boundary
tooling_audit.purpose: Define shared capability ownership and preserve project-owned delivery requirements.
tooling_audit.recommendation: Use project-owned adapters for forms, approvals, and controlled records; import shared skills without replacing those adapters.
